delete.description: Revoke one of the caller's own devices. 404 for unknown, foreign or already revoked ones.

post.description: Redeem an enrolment code once; return the raw device token (shown once).
Add a concept under a topic the caller can see. 404 otherwise.
Derived state of a block of concepts from the caller's marks. 404 when any concept is not visible.

get.description: Concepts the caller ignores, ordered by concept id.

schema.title: Response List Ignored Route Concepts Ignored Get

get.description: Every concept mark of the caller, ordered by concept id. Other users' marks are never listed.

schema.title: Response List Concept Marks Route Concepts Marks Get

get.description: Visible concepts the caller does not ignore, sorted by `sort` in `order`. A bad sort or order gives 422.

schema.title: Response Sorted Concepts Route Concepts Sorted Get

delete.description:
Hard-delete a concept the caller owns, with its marks, aliases and ignore rows.
404 when not visible, 403 when the concept is shared.

get.description: Shared aliases and the caller's own aliases of a visible concept. 404 otherwise.

schema.title: Response List Concept Aliases Route Concepts  Concept Id  Aliases Get

post.description: Add a private alias the caller owns to a visible concept. 404 otherwise, 409 when the alias exists.

put.description: Set the definition of a concept the caller owns. 404 when not visible, 403 when the concept is shared.

delete.description: Show a concept in the caller's lists again. 404 when the caller does not ignore it.

put.description: Hide a visible concept from the caller's lists. Its marks stay. 404 when not visible.

delete.description: Remove the caller's mark on a concept. 404 when the caller has no such mark.

put.description: Set the caller's mark on a visible concept. 404 when the concept is not visible to the caller.

post.description: Stamp the last-viewed time of a visible concept. 404 when the concept is not visible to the caller.
The user's open session, or a new one. An open session that has gone idle ends first.

get.description: One of the user's sessions. 404 for another user's id or an unknown id.

post.description: End the session by the user's button. Idempotent: a session already ended returns 200 unchanged.
Store the exam result on the session. 422 when the score is over the cap.

Record one captured question. 202 queued, 200 when the position is already recorded.

409 when the session has ended. 422 when the question is over `max_question_chars`. The row is
`skipped` with no lane item when the analysis task needs the cloud and no token is set. The row is
`failed` and the answer 503 when the lane is full. The question text is never logged or returned.

Body: the exam result JSON (see kata_core.exams.parse). Stores it as pending and changes no mark.
422 when the payload is malformed, is not UTF-8, or names a concept the caller cannot see.
413 when the body passes `[exams] max_import_bytes`, by Content-Length or by the bytes streamed.

Confirm the listed concepts of the caller's pending result; correct ones are marked Known.
404 when the result or a concept is not the caller's or not visible; 409 when the result is not pending.
Dismiss the caller's pending result. Marks are unchanged. 404 when not the caller's; 409 when not pending.
Body: UTF-8 text, one 'Category / Topic [= Alias]' per line. A bad line or non-UTF-8 body is 422 and changes nothing.

Queue a job of `kind` (tag when none) for the caller.

409 `needs_cloud` when that kind needs the cloud and no cloud token is set; nothing is queued.
422 when a modelhost kind has a payload its allow-list refuses; nothing is queued.

get.description: Lease the caller's oldest claimable job of the `?kind=` kinds (tag when none). 204 when none.
Status of the caller's job. `known` is computed from the caller's marks. 404 for other users' jobs.

post.description: Mark a job the caller leased as failed. 404 when the job is not the caller's or not leased.

Store the output of a job the caller leased, then run its kind's output hook in the same tx.

413 above `[jobs] max_output_bytes`. 404 when the job is not the caller's or not leased.
422 when its kind has no output hook (nothing is stored). 422 when the hook rejects the reply
(ValueError or TypeError): nothing is stored and the job is marked failed.

Complete a job the caller leased, with a shared topic for `category` and `topic`.

The topic is created when missing. 404 when the job is not the caller's or not leased.

get.description:
The oldest unserved cached joke, marked served. Every call also refills the cache for the caller.

404 `jokes disabled` when `[jokes] enabled` is false; 404 `no joke cached` when the cache is empty.
The 404 after a refill is a response, not an exception, so the queued refill still commits.
The enabled joke sources, in list order. Empty when `[jokes] enabled` is false.

schema.title: Response List Sources Jokes Sources Get

post.description: State of each concept for the caller. 404 when any concept is not visible to the caller.

get.description: Every mark of the caller, with topic and category names, ordered by topic id. Other users' marks are never listed.

delete.description: Remove the caller's mark on a topic. 404 when the caller has no such mark.

put.description: Set the caller's mark on a visible topic. 404 when the topic is not visible to the caller.

post.description: Answer one JSON-RPC message. 204 when no reply is due (a notification).

Check one answer in core. A correct answer moves the concept from New to Learning only.

404 when the question or the concept is not visible to the caller; 422 when the choice is not one of the question's choices.

get.description: Up to `mini_quiz_size` cached questions (at most 5). No answer index, with the source link, tier and licence.

schema.title: Response Get Mini Quiz Quiz Mini Get

post.description:
Queue a fetch of an allowlisted source. 400 when the URL is not on the allowlist, before any fetch.

409 `needs_cloud` when the quiz generate task needs a cloud token that is not set; nothing is queued.

get.description: Status, page count, text and error of the caller's document. 404 for other users' documents.

The raw bytes of the caller's document, for the worker, with its stored media type.

404 for other users' documents and for documents whose content is already gone.

post.description:
Remember the concept the caller picked for a word in a visible topic.

404 when the topic or concept is not visible to the caller; 422 when the concept belongs to another topic.

get.description:
The caller's cached classification of a page. 404 when the caller has none for it.

Cached candidates are matched against the caller's visible topics; a candidate with no visible topic is dropped.
Concepts of a visible topic with the caller's mark state and counts. 404 when the topic is not visible.

schema.title: Response Get Scan Overview Scan Overview Get

post.description: Move the caller's word from one concept to another and teach the alias. Marks are not changed.

get.description: The cached summary for (url, text_sha256). 404 when none is cached.

post.description:
Return the cached summary (200 `{status: done, summary}`), or queue one (202 `{id}`).

413 when the text is longer than `[summary] max_text_chars`; 422 when the text holds a prompt marker.
409 `needs_cloud` when the summary task needs a cloud token that is not set; nothing is queued.

get.description: Shared topics and the caller's own private topics.

schema.title: Response List Topics Route Topics Get

post.description: Create (or find) a topic. private true makes it the caller's own; default is shared.
Add an alias the caller owns to a topic the caller can see. 404 otherwise.

get.description: The caller's spend and call count for today (UTC). Zeros when nothing is recorded.

post.description: Add spend to the caller's row for today (UTC) and count one call.

get.description:
One page of the caller's courses, newest first. `next_before_id` is set when the page is full.

`limit` and `total` let the client show the course limit and how many courses are used.

post.description:
Queue a course for the given concepts, or for the caller's gaps when none are named.

The course row and its `course.generate` job are written in one transaction. 422 when the title
is empty, the rule finds nothing to study, or names a concept the caller cannot see. 409
`needs_cloud` when the generate task needs a cloud token that is not set. 409
`course_limit` when the caller is at the limit, 409 `course_name_taken` when the title is taken.
Errors return before the job is queued, so nothing is written.

delete.description: Delete one course of the caller. 404 when it is missing or belongs to another user.

get.description: One course of the caller. 404 when it is missing or belongs to another user.

post.description: A signed open link for one ready course of the caller.

schema.title: Response Open Course Route V1 Courses  Course Id  Open Post

get.description: The course's progress document and its revision. 404 for a missing or foreign course.

patch.description:
Merge a delta (`items` by id) into the stored document when `If-Match` is the stored revision.

Same codes as PUT. 412 also when no document is stored yet (revision 0, `doc` null): PUT first.
Evidence is written for the delta's items only.

put.description:
Save the progress document when `If-Match` is the stored revision.

428 without `If-Match`, 400 when malformed, 413 above `[trainer] max_progress_bytes`,
412 with the current document on a revision mismatch, 409 when the course is not ready,
404 for a missing or foreign course. `?import=1` stores the document without writing evidence.

post.description:
Regenerate a course in place: same id, version+1, concepts carried over plus new gaps.

404 when the course is missing or foreign. 409 `course_busy` while it is queued, generating or
building. 409 `needs_cloud` as for create. 422 `nothing_to_study` when no concept is left.

get.description:
What regenerating the course would keep, add and drop, against the caller's current marks.

404 when the course is missing or belongs to another user. Nothing is written.

post.description: Decide an open point and journal `plan.decision`. 404 when missing, foreign, decided or a bad switch.

Ingest one batch for the caller. Only accepted events reach the policy; its decisions
are queued, then the caller's pending messages are delivered in this response.

`reason` is only sent for rejected events (`exclude_unset`), so accepted results omit it.

get.description: One page of the caller's entries below `before_id`. `next_before_id` is set when the page is full.
The caller's lists in name order, each with its item count.

schema.title: Response List All Route V1 Lists Get

post.description: Create an empty list. 409 when the user already has a list with the same name; 422 when blank.

get.description: The caller's lists that hold `concept_id`. 404 when the concept is not visible to the caller.

schema.title: Response Lists Of Concept Route V1 Lists Concept  Concept Id  Get

delete.description: Delete the caller's list and its items. Courses made from it are kept. 404 when not owned.

patch.description: Rename the caller's list. 404 when not owned; 409 when the new name is taken; 422 when blank.

post.description:
Add concepts to the caller's list. 404 when the list is not owned; 422 when any concept is
unknown or not visible to the caller (nothing is added then). Re-adding is not an error.

delete.description:
Remove a concept from the caller's list. 404 when the list is not owned or the concept is not
in it.

post.description:
Queue a course for the concepts of the caller's list. The list is kept. 404 when the list is not
owned; 422 when it has no concepts, a concept is not visible, or the title is empty. Other course
errors (409) are those of `POST /v1/courses`.

Add every concept of a visible topic to the caller's list. 404 when the list is not owned or
the topic is not visible to the caller.

get.description: Deliver and return the caller's pending messages, oldest first. Each is returned once.
The caller's allocation as of the clock: per track, the placed items and the deferred positions.

put.description: Set the weekly budget and journal the change in one transaction.

get.description: The caller's concepts matching the filters, sorted by `sort` in `order`. A bad sort or order gives 422.

schema.title: Response Review Concepts Route V1 Review Concepts Get

schema.title: Response Review Tree Route V1 Review Tree Get

get.description: One page of the caller's syllabi, newest first. `next_before_id` is set when the page is full.

Import a syllabus: parse it into modules, link them to visible concepts, return the triage.

413 when the text is over `[syllabus] max_bytes`, 422 when it is blank. With `model_extract` on and
no structure found, a `syllabus.extract` job is queued in the same transaction and the answer is 202
with its `job_id`.

delete.description: Delete one syllabus of the caller. 404 when it is missing or belongs to another user.

get.description: One syllabus of the caller with its triage. 404 when it is missing or belongs to another user.
One page of the caller's tracks, newest first. `next_before_id` is set when the page is full.

post.description: Create an active track with its items and journal `plan.track_changed`. 422 on a foreign module.

delete.description: Delete a track with its items and points, and journal `plan.track_changed`. 404 when not the caller's.

get.description: One track of the caller. 404 when it is missing or belongs to another user.

patch.description: Change the given fields (`items` replaces all) and journal `plan.track_changed`. 404 when not the caller's.

post.description: Open a decision point on a track of the caller. 404 when the track is missing or foreign.

get.description: The goals of the track with progress, velocity and pace. 404 when the track is not the caller's.

Create a named list holding the goal's concepts that are not known yet (D14).

409 when the user already has a list with that name; 422 when the name is blank.
Add a text source and link its concept ids to the goal. 422, nothing stored, when a concept is unknown or private.
